maya: Hey hi! First week q: trying to sketch a quick who-to-ping map for common onboarding blocks (VPC peering, private deploys, model rollouts, canaries, creds). Who owns what? sam: Welcome Maya! short answer: split across infra/platform/runtime/product. eng-infra handles low-level network & creds, eng-platform owns VPC/private-deploy UX, eng-runtime runs rollout tooling, product owns rollout policy & approvals. jordan: product here 60: for rollout approvals/QA tagging, add @product and the feature PM. For canaries follow the runtime canary checklist (link in org wiki). lina: I'll add you to the "onboard contacts" sheet and the org chart. FYI people-ops handles account provisioning, but if it's cloud infra access ping eng-infra after people-ops grants baseline. alex: runtime note: runtime-oncall pages are the fastest route for failing canaries. Our oncall rotation is in #eng-oncall. For nonblocking rollout help open the "rollout-help" ops ticket. oncall-bot: @runtime-oncall is on call 2026-03-25 08:00-20:00 PST (primary: Alex.R). sam: Quick copy for your notes: `` Who-to-ping cheatsheet: - VPC / peering / infra creds: @eng-infra (Sam K, Priya)
- Private deploy orchestration: @eng-platform - Model rollouts & canaries: @eng-runtime + @product - P1 incidents (rollout causing outages): page #eng-oncall, notify @eng-sre and product leads - SLA / incidents: @eng-sre - Dedicated capacity / contracts: @sales-ops - Onboarding account issues: @people-ops ``` maya: super useful. Do we have a short escalation path for rollout regressions (like who to page for P1 vs P2)? jordan: yes 60: P1 -> page eng-sre + eng-runtime + product leads and your manager; P2 -> page eng-runtime and create incident ticket; P3 -> ticket to runtime/product as appropriate. We log the P1 pages in the scribe channel for follow-up. lina: I'll share the runbook and add you to the sheet with rotation times. Also tagging you in the onboarding doc: https://company.internal/onboarding/owners (SSO needed). alex: If you're blocked onboarding-wise (creds, kube access, VPC), reply with exact error and I'll escalate to infra leads. maya: thanks everyone 60: saving the cheatsheet and checking the runbook. Appreciate the speedy responses :thumbsup: sam: Welcome aboard Maya! ping here if any of the links need updating, lots of docs get stale.
